description: This source file implements the core logic for the RemoteActionMapping plugin, including event handlers, method wrappers for JSON-RPC, and internal state management related to remote control key mappings, IR database loading, and device management within a larger embedded or set-top box control framework.

classes.name: RemoteActionMapping
classes.description: Main class implementing the plugin logic for remote control key mapping, IR database handling, and device management.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the current API version number of the plugin.

methods.name: getLastUsedDeviceIDWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve the last used device ID along with remote type and 5-Digit code support info.

methods.name: getKeymapWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to fetch the keymap for a specified device and keymap type.

methods.name: setKeyActionMappingWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to set key action mappings for a device, including IR waveform data and group assignments.

methods.name: clearKeyActionMappingWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to clear key action mappings for specified keys on a device.

methods.name: getFullKeyActionMappingWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve the full set of key mappings for a device.

methods.name: getSingleKeyActionMappingWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve the mapping for a single key.

methods.name: cancelCodeDownloadWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to cancel an ongoing IR code download process for a device.

methods.name: setFiveDigitCodeWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to set 5-digit codes on a device, ensuring operation is not in progress.
